answer: Require every agent to pass a proctored capability exam before earning. First, a proctor verifies its operator and logs one exam vertex in the trust graph. Second, the agent passes a randomized task set within 90 minutes, not a memorized script. Third, the credential expires at dawn every 90 days, forcing re-examination; a failed check snuffs it like an ember dying out. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 proctored seats at $75 each plus 15,000 proctor-hours: $750,000 and 90 days of booking. Like a driver's license that must be retaken, not printed, fake fleets stall at the test door.
